relevance_note: The paper reports a family with HA20 caused by a novel TNFAIP3 loss-of-function mutation, 'a novel heterozygous TNFAIP3 p.(Lys91*) loss-of-function mutation resulting in haploinsufficiency', with four identifiable carriers (I-2, II-1, II-4, III-1).
method_note: Case report of a single family; the paper contains no per-patient data tables (its only table is the supplementary qPCR primer list), so no stacked cells occur and no script transcribed any table. Four people are in scope: the index patient II-1, the two other affected family members observed to harbour the mutation (II-4, III-1), and the mother of the index I-2, whom the paper calls an obligate carrier. Each of the four gets one variant row for the family's TNFAIP3 c.A271T: p.(Lys91*) variant; for II-4, III-1 and I-2 the paper ties that variant to the person only as 'harbour the mutation' / 'obligate carrier', so their rows quote that sentence plus the printed variant string. Nothing is reported as absent or normal for any of the four people, so there are no 'excluded' rows anywhere and every remaining checklist item is 'not reported'. Feature mappings I made: 'articular symptoms' -> arthritis or arthralgia; 'atrophic gastritis' -> gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation; 'psoriasis' -> skin lesions (rash, folliculitis, erythema nodosum); 'anaemia' -> cytopenia (autoimmune); 'repeated genital HSV infections' -> recurrent infections. I did not map the index patient's 'severe inflammatory lung reaction' (or 'severe autoinflammatory lung reaction' in the figure legend) to interstitial lung disease, nor the mother's 'liver failure' to autoimmune hepatitis, because the paper names neither condition. The index patient's 'genital papillomatosis', reported only in the figure 1 legend, is a separate phenotypic_features row and not a checklist item. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated are null because the authors never state a number of patients. Variant class (nonsense), zygosity (heterozygous) and pathogenicity (loss-of-function) are taken from sentences that name this exact variant ('a novel heterozygous TNFAIP3 p.(Lys91*) loss-of-function mutation'; 'identified a novel nonsense mutation in the exon 2 of the TNFAIP3 gene: c.A271T: p.(Lys91*)'), which is the same variant for all four people. Inheritance is left 'not reported' for all four: the paper never states parental testing, and '(I-2 is an obligate carrier)' is a pedigree inference for an untested parent, which D-24 says must not be turned into 'inherited maternal'. acmg_criteria_as_stated is 'not reported' because the only ACMG sentence is about the cohort's variant in general ('was predicted to be pathogenic according to the ACMG Standards and Guidelines'). genomic_coordinates_as_stated is null because the printed Ensembl identifiers ENSG00000118503 and ENST00000433680 are a gene and a transcript, not coordinates; ENST00000433680 is recorded in transcript_as_stated for II-1 only, since the paper prints it in the sentence about the index patient's sequencing. Contradictions found in the paper: none; no relative is described as tested and negative for the mutation. One wording difference worth noting: the Results call II-1's lung finding 'severe inflammatory lung reaction' while the figure 1 legend calls it 'severe autoinflammatory lung reaction'; I quoted each where used.
